What is a Packet?

A packet is a small unit of data sent over a network. Large data transfers are broken into many packets.

What Wireshark Does

Wireshark captures network traffic so security analysts can inspect what data is being sent between devices in real time.

Security Insight

If a login is sent over unencrypted HTTP, Wireshark may reveal usernames and passwords in plain text.
